code_names.instructions: Every name of code the ticket mentions: functions, methods, types, classes, variables, constants, config keys, CLI flags and package names. Write each exactly as in the text, one per item. Not file paths and not plain English words.

file_paths.instructions: Every file or folder path the ticket mentions, such as src/a/b.ts or packages/x/README.md, exactly as written. Not URLs and not code names.

error_messages.instructions: Every error message, failing assertion or compiler or test output the ticket quotes, exactly as written.
